user.title: Connect to Casambi Cloud
user.description: Enter your Casambi Cloud API key and credentials. Provide at least one password: the user (site) password, the network password, or both.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Casambi Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The Casambi Cloud rejected the stored credentials for {email}. Enter a valid API key and at least one password to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Casambi Cloud
reconfigure.description: Update your Casambi Cloud credentials. Provide at least one password.

error.no_password: Enter at least one password (user or network).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Casambi Cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.rate_limited: The Casambi Cloud is rate limiting requests. Wait a little and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Casambi account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials are for a different Casambi account.

init.title: Casambi Cloud options
init.description: Tune polling, timeouts, reconnection and alerting. Changes reload the integration.

confirm.title: Reconnect to the Casambi Cloud
confirm.description: The Casambi Cloud connection has been failing (last error: {error}, after {failures} consecutive problems). Select Submit to reload the integration and try to reconnect.

gateway_offline.title: Casambi gateway offline
gateway_offline.description: No Casambi gateway is currently reachable for your network. Lights cannot be controlled from the cloud until a gateway (a mains-powered unit with cloud access, or the Casambi app in gateway mode) is online again. Check the gateway device's power and network/Bluetooth connectivity.

command_timeout.message: Timed out sending the command to {entity}.

command_failed.message: The Casambi Cloud rejected the command ({error}).

light_turn_on.name: Set brightness and distribution
light_turn_on.description: Turn a Casambi light on with an explicit brightness and, optionally, a light-distribution (vertical) value.

distribution.name: Distribution
distribution.description: Light distribution (vertical) from 0 to 255, for fixtures that support it.
